data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Audit gates on .reconciler-phase-gate file presence OR operator comment transitioning audit state. Refuse to execute against unadvanced state with clear 'phase not advanced' message

Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh as sourceable shell library exporting check_phase_gate <phase> function. Checks .reconciler-phase-gate file (tickets branch worktree) content matches requested phase, OR operator-comment marker in .reconciler-phase-gate.ops (one phase per line). On failure: print 'phase not advanced: phase=<N> gate_missing' to stderr, exit 2. On success: exit 0. When invoked directly with phase arg, behaves as CLI. Shared gate consumed by task-2/3/4/5 (Rule of Three: 4 call sites at introduction).

## Test Approach
Given no .reconciler-phase-gate; When check_phase_gate 1 invoked; Then exit 2 + stderr contains 'phase not advanced: phase=1 gate_missing'. Given .reconciler-phase-gate containing '1'; When check_phase_gate 1 invoked; Then exit 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] shellcheck + executable: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh && test -x plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh
- [ ] Missing gate returns exit 2 with diagnostic
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_missing_gate_exits_2
- [ ] Present matching gate returns exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_present_gate_exits_0
- [ ] Operator-comment marker .reconciler-phase-gate.ops returns exit 0
  Verify: bash tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh::test_ops_marker_exits_0

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/audits/audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh — Create
- tests/unit/scripts/test_audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
